author: r. a. duran
title: Representative James Spillane promotes new book and comments on education policy
text:
Representative James Spillane, a member of the New Hampshire House of Representatives, posted several statements on his Twitter account on May 20, 2026. The tweets included commentary on educational issues and a promotion for his book.
In one post published at 00:56 UTC, Spillane responded to an unspecified claim with the brief comment: “Mostly true.”
Later that morning, at 11:20 UTC, he shared a promotional message for his book under the persona of David Goggins. The tweet read: “**WEDNESDAY, MAY 20, 2026 – TIME TO MOVE**
I don’t do soft recommendations. If something is worth your time, I’m going to tell you straight.
*The Sisyphus Project* by James Spillane is worth your damn time.
This book doesn’t hand you fluff. It” The tweet references “The Sisyphus Project,” authored by Spillane himself.
Shortly after, at 11:23 UTC, Spillane commented on current tensions in education policy debates with the statement: “So many teachers don’t realize parents are fed up and their time of subversion is over.”
Spillane’s remarks come amid ongoing national discussions about parental involvement in education and debates over school curricula and teacher autonomy. These topics have been particularly prominent in recent years as policymakers and advocacy groups address concerns from both educators and families regarding classroom content and decision-making authority.
